answer: Mutual insurance pool: each new agent must buy cover from a pool funded by existing members, priced by how many recent joins share its funding source. The delta between premiums grows with each sibling wallet, so the tenth sable-tagged clone pays far more than the first. If a sybil ring still drains a reward, the opal reserve repays victims and underwriters lose their stake, so insurers have reason to refuse correlated newcomers.
